proof_markdown:
## Theorem

Let `z_1,…,z_m` label the vertices of an undirected `d`-regular rotation multigraph with integral symmetric port multiplicities. Label every directed port `u→v` by `z_u+z_v`, so the raw length is `M=md`. Suppose certification at length `n=2^30` uses only

`β=ε²+λ(1−ε²)`

and the generic adjustment inequality

`βM+|n−M|≤T`, where `T=2^21`, `ε` is the maximum absolute bias of the translated vertex-label characters, and `λ` bounds every nonprincipal absolute eigenvalue of normalized adjacency. Then the edge-label span has dimension at most 837. Padding or puncturing cannot increase this dimension, and adjoining one all-one row gives dimension at most 838.

## 1. Adjustment and trace

For `M≤n`, adjustment gives

`β≤1−(n−T)/M`,

which increases up to `T/n`; for `M≥n`, it gives

`β≤(n+T)/M−1`,

which decreases from `T/n`. Hence `β≤1/512`. Since `β≥ε²` and `β≥λ`,

`ε²≤1/512`, `λ≤1/512`.

Let `P=(a_uv/d)` be normalized adjacency. Integral symmetric multiplicities give

`tr(P²)=d^-2 Σ_uv a_uv²≥m/d`,

while the spectral bound gives

`tr(P²)≤1+(m−1)/512²`.

Consequently

`d≥ceil(262144m/(m+262143))`.

Also `md≤n+T=1,075,838,976`. The lower bound on `d` is nondecreasing, and

`34915·30812=1,075,800,980≤n+T`,

`34916·30813=1,075,866,708>n+T`.

Thus `m≤34,915`.

Because `λ<1`, the graph is connected. With `e_i=z_i+z_1`, path summation shows that the edge-label span equals `H=span{e_1,…,e_m}`. Put `h=dim H`; note that `e_1=0`.

## 2. The 186th-moment lemma

For `a∈H*`, put

`W_a=Σ_i(-1)^{a(e_i)}`.

Every nonprincipal character obeys `W_a^186≤A`, where

`A=(m²/512)^93`.

Let `Z` count ordered 186-tuples of indices whose labels sum to zero. Fourier orthogonality gives

`2^h Z=Σ_a W_a^186≤m^186+(2^h−1)A`.  (1)

Tuples using 93 distinct indices exactly twice contribute

`L=(m)_93·185!!`,

so `Z≥L`.

If `m≤838`, then `h≤m−1≤837`. Assume `839≤m≤34915` and define

`R(m)=L/A=512^93(m)_93·185!!/m^186`.

For real `m>184`,

`d(log R)/dm=Σ_{i=0}^{92}1/(m−i)−186/m≤93/(m−92)−186/m<0`.

Thus `R(m)≥R(34915)`.

Set `M_0=34915`. First,

`(M_0)_93/M_0^93=Π_{i=0}^{92}(1−i/M_0)≥1−4278/M_0=30637/34915`.  (2)

It remains to bound `Q=512^93·185!!/M_0^93`. Since

`185!!=2^-93 Π_{j=94}^{186}j`,

pairing around 140 gives

`Q=c q^46 F`,

where

`c=256·140/M_0`,

`q=256²·19600/M_0²`,

`F=Π_{s=1}^{46}(1−s²/19600)`.

Exact cross multiplication gives

`c>1283/1250` because the numerator difference is `4055`, and

`q>1317/1250` because the numerator difference is `133,634,675`.

Furthermore,

`(1317/1250)^46=(1+67/1250)^46>Σ_{j=0}^6 binom(46,j)(67/1250)^j>219/20`;  (3)

the last difference is exactly

`8,219,586,749,760,411 / 3,814,697,265,625,000,000 >0`.

To control `F`, put `x_s=s²/19600` and `a=46²/19600=529/4900`. From

`log(1−x)≥−x−x²/[2(1−a)]` for `0≤x≤a`,

and the exact sums `Σs²=33511`, `Σs⁴=43,463,767`, we obtain

`log F≥−166819/94080>−9/5`.  (4)

Finally, with `z=21/29`,

`log(25/4)=2Σ_{j≥0}z^(2j+1)/(2j+1)>2(z+z³/3+z⁵/5+z⁷/7)>9/5`;

the final difference is `940,216,611/86,249,381,545`. Hence (4) implies `F>4/25`.

Combining these estimates,

`Q>(1283/1250)(219/20)(4/25)=280977/156250>7/4`.

Together with (2),

`R(34915)>(7/4)(30637/34915)>3/2`,

where the final integer comparison is `214459>209490`.

Therefore `L−A>A/2=m^186/2^838`. Substituting `Z≥L` into (1) yields

`2^h(L−A)≤m^186−A<m^186`,

and hence `2^h<2^838`. Since `h` is integral, `h≤837`.

## 3. Architecture consequence

Deleting columns cannot increase rank and adding zero columns preserves it. Thus generic puncturing or padding leaves dimension at most 837. One independent all-one row raises it by at most one, giving the claimed ceiling 838. This is an obstruction only for the explicitly stated certificate architecture.

proof_steps.proof: Analyze the two rational branches of `(T−|n−M|)/M`; both attain their maximum at `M=n`. Thus `β≤T/n=1/512`, strengthening the earlier `1/511` relaxation.

Integral port multiplicities give `tr(P²)≥m/d`, while `λ≤1/512` gives `tr(P²)≤1+(m−1)/512²`. Hence `d≥ceil(262144m/(m+262143))`. The exact boundary products at `m=34915,34916` and `md≤n+T` give `m≤34915`.
proof_steps.statement: Every sampler in scope has at most 34,915 vertices.

proof_steps.proof: The 186th Fourier identity and the contribution from 93 distinct indices used twice give `2^hZ=Σ_aW_a^186` and `Z≥(m)_93·185!!`. Monotonicity reduces the normalized comparison to `m=34915`; the exact rational calculation in the proof establishes a ratio greater than `3/2`, yielding `2^h<2^838`.
proof_steps.statement: A translated label system with `m≤34915` and nonprincipal squared bias at most `1/512` has span dimension at most 837.

proof_steps.proof: Connectivity identifies the edge-label span with the translated-label span. Puncturing and zero-padding do not increase rank; a constant row adds at most one.
proof_steps.statement: The complete directed-edge scalar-mixing architecture has homogeneous dimension at most 837 and augmented dimension at most 838.

theorem_statement: At `n=2^30` and target absolute bias `1/512`, every complete directed-edge XOR lift of an undirected regular rotation multigraph whose distance is certified only by `β=ε²+λ(1−ε²)` and generic padding or puncturing has homogeneous dimension at most 837 and dimension at most 838 after one all-one augmentation.
